note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The sections, their pieces and every date are supplied placeholders: nothing states which sections a filing needs, a time limit, a fee, a court, admissibility or any consequence. A pending section is only empty in the configured example.
